Results.ReviewText:
We decided upon the new Ironwood 650 for our first pellet smoker.  I’ve always had a huge desire to learn how to smoke delicious meat but lack the time to operate and babysit a traditional smoker.  Traeger’s new for 2019 features and the new Ironwood model was a perfect fit.  Assembly was easy and seasoning the grill was a cinch.  Our first smoke was a beef brisket.  Used a recipe from the Traeger app.  Was blown away with how simple it was and the fantastic results!  We started searching for recipes all over the internet.  Found a great recipe for pork shoulder “Boston Butt” for pulled pork on Heygrillhey and produced the best pulled pork I’ve ever eaten!  Have produced over a dozen more since.  Usually smoke two at a time which doesn’t add much time to the smoke.  We save the pulled pork with our food saver in 1-2 lbs packages and currently have over 60 lbs in the freezer for easy meals going forward.  We usually start the smoke around 7 pm and it finishes around 10 am the following day.  The meat needs to rest wrapped in tinfoil for about 60-90 minutes in a cooler and is ready for a noon meal.  

Other reviewers state that you need a strong WiFi signal which we found to be true.  We had to purchase a network extender to boost our signal to the deck where the Traeger is located.  Once we solved that issue, the WiFi app is amazing!  It’s fun to monitor the progress on the grill.  We use the probe all the time and have had no issues.  We calibrated the probe per the instructions and it works flawlessly.  We constantly check it with a high end grilling probe and they are within 5* of each other when inserted into the same hole.  My only complaint is that the Ironwood 650 only has a single probe.  We usually montitor multiple roasts with our handheld probe while the Traeger probe gives a current status at all times.

Maintenance is easy!  Our app sends us great recipes and also a care/use guidelines which we follow regularly.  We store our grill using a genuine Traeger cover which is of very high quality.  Also purchased a drumstick/wing rack and haven’t used it yet but hope to soon!  We use Traeger pellets and have noticed nice changes in flavor profiles when switching pellets.  Our favorites have been the pecan or apple wood for pork and hickory for beef.  

Grilling steaks and burgers with the reverse sear has had mediocre results.  I guess I’m accustomed to the beautiful high temp searing from my Big Green Egg.  Ribeye steaks seared on the Traeger have more of a prime rib roast flavor and texture that melt in your mouth but lack the charred outside sear I crave.  I’ll probably stick to my Egg for grilling steaks and burgers per my personal preference.  

Overall, we LOVE our Traeger Ironwood!  The downdraft smoke with the thin blue smoke produces exactly as advertised.  We hope it lasts many many years and continues to wow our family and friends with spectacular results.  Highly recommend this smoker and all Traeger products!

Results.ReviewText: Controller upgrade is great, lighting and shutting down the unit is a breeze.  Not a huge fan of the double racks, really tight to get to the back but the heat seems to be much more even than previous models of pellet grills I own.
Results.Title: Ironwood 650

Results.ReviewText: This is one versatile cooker. I’ve done brisket, ribs, chicken, steaks, pork shoulders/butts with fantastic results.  I own a wood smoker, drum smoker, charcoal grill, and gas grill and this grill outperforms them all.  Easiest grill to operate. Love the WiFi connectivity. Well worth every penny. My only regret is I didn’t buy the bigger one.
Results.Title: If I could give it 10 stars I would.
